desc: Derive per-case formulas for counting valid right pairs given left pair composition relative to middle value v
Implement sliding right-frequency map with incremental maintenance of cntV (f[nums[i]]) and sumC2 = Σ_x C(f[x],2)
For each middle i, iterate all left pairs (a,b), classify into lv=2 / lv=1 (with y) / lv=0 (y=z or y≠z), accumulate valid right-pair counts via formulas
Handle mod 1e9+7 carefully (negative subtractions) and edge cases (fewer than 2 elements on a side)
Brute-force verify against given examples and random small arrays (n≤8) with exhaustive C(n,5) enumeration
